title: LLM Application Testing Foundation
goal: Add a safely scoped first slice for AI/LLM application testing against authorized targets.
scope: Design and implement a controlled LLM-application probe runner for approved LLM API endpoints, covering prompt-injection, data-leakage, unsafe-tool-use, and excessive-refusal baseline checks where safely testable. Keep target scope explicit and operator-approved.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found AI/LLM target testing was documented but not queued as an executable package.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Test only explicitly authorized LLM endpoints with bounded prompts. Do not harvest secrets, bypass customer controls, or mutate external systems.
notes: Provider keys and target tokens must use protected secret handling.
Probe content must be safe, bounded, and documented.

success_criteria: A first LLM application test profile or runner path exists for explicitly authorized endpoints.
Prompt-injection and leakage probes produce evidence-backed, bounded findings or safe no-finding output.
Operator scope, rate limits, and safety constraints are visible.
Tests cover deterministic fake-provider behavior and unsafe/missing-target fallbacks.
No uncontrolled external tool use or runtime self-modification is introduced.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: LLM tests require explicit authorized target configuration.
Probe output is bounded, safe, and evidence-backed.
No uncontrolled plugin/tool execution is introduced.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Safe prompt set, target authorization, and provider-secret handling are defined.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with LLM testing changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the LLM testing baseline and remaining AI attack-surface limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Shadow AI discovery across customer networks
